name: Norma Kamali

prices.note: All 225 items in the dresses collection are regular price (no compare_at above price). Low: Convertible dress $135; top: Oversized Sleeveless NK Flared Gown $575. Median $225. Diana Mini Dress $195 and Cayla Side Drape Gown $195 (95% polyester, 5% spandex, hand or machine wash).

notes: Homepage meta: 'in the fashion industry for over 50 years… known for her innovative designs. She designed the Sleeping Bag Coat… as well as multi-style jersey dresses.' About: 'HER COLLECTIONS ARE ALWAYS WASHABLE AND EASY CARE'; HQ in the West Village, New York. founded_year not stated as a year.
meta.json: shop address New York, US; currency USD; ships_to (64 countries) includes US, CA, GB, AU.
Shipping policy: FedEx Ground 'Complementary Outbound' (free), 1-5 days; FedEx 2Day $15; Overnight $30; Manhattan same-day $45.

Refund policy: full-priced apparel returnable within 30 days of delivery for a refund to the original payment; $8.95 deducted if its FedEx label is used; final-sale discounted, Vintage and NORMALIFE items excluded.
Size options across the dresses collection: XXS, XS, S, M, L, XL (some XS/S, M/L).
us_stores left empty: About mentions 'her store' at the West Village HQ but the showrooms page lists wholesale showrooms, not a store locator.
